揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: air or sea route ： For departures from DABER heading north: after passing DABER, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to TEBON or XLN, and then to QO to join the airway. for the flight back to ZGOW, ATC may instruct the aircraft to flyfrom QO to XLN or TEBON, and then to DABER to join the arrival procedure. For ZGOW-ZGKL flights:after takeoff and upon crossing airway X63, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to SHL, followed by VEROK. For ZSNJ (Nanjing) arrivals: ATC will instruct the aircraft to flyvia EMRID to airway V143 and then to OLRIS. After OLRIS, the aircraft will proceed to SNQ (Shiqiu) or receive radar vectors to join the appropriate approach procedure. The final waypoint listed on the clearance isGOSRO (via W135). Upon passing KAKIS (the entry point to the arrival corridor), control is handled by Hangzhou Approach; the handover to Nanjing Approach often occurs late, creating a risk of flying the wrong arrival or departure route. Itis recommended to confirm the arrival procedure in advance. 4. ZGHA-ZGOW Route: After passing BEMAG, follow ATC radar vectoring to aheading of 120°, then proceed direct to NUVGA to intercept Route H25 towards QU; for the approach, follow instructions to join the QU-9WA arrival route.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For the ILS approach to Runway 22: When arriving via IAF OW556, terrain effects may result in a higher-than-normal profile, potentially leading to a high intercept; flight crews should be aware of this and are advised to extend flaps to Configuration 2 before turning final approach.and crew may also request descend 700 meters to avoid high interception.

杭州萧山.source_text_en: Numerous ongoing construction works with aerodrome operational complexity. When ATC issues taxi hold instructions, some taxiway junctions are not equipped with holding position markings (e.g., prior to D8 on Taxiway C, prior to C on Taxiway D5). Crew shall maintain visual lookout, control holding position with adequate margin to prevent conflict with other aircraft.

杭州萧山.source_text_en: Selection between SUPAR and OKTUG arrival waypoints: For inbound traffic from OKTUG-SUPAR direction, both the final waypoint SUPAR and penultimate waypoint OKTUG in flightplan contain arrival procedures. ATC may assign OKTUG arrival procedure. Confirm arrival procedure with ATC to prevent incorrect arrival track.

zh.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

zh.source_text_en: For the ILS approach to Runway 22: When arriving via IAF OW556, terrain effects may result in a higher-than-normal profile, potentially leading to a high intercept; flight crews should be aware of this and are advised to extend flaps to Configuration 2 before turning final approach.and crew may also request descend 700 meters to avoid high interception.

zh.source_text_en: Numerous ongoing construction works with aerodrome operational complexity. When ATC issues taxi hold instructions, some taxiway junctions are not equipped with holding position markings (e.g., prior to D8 on Taxiway C, prior to C on Taxiway D5). Crew shall maintain visual lookout, control holding position with adequate margin to prevent conflict with other aircraft.

Crew shall anticipate, manage energy in advance, maintain active communication and accept radar vectors as required. When executing capture glideslope from above, strictly follow SOP. If stable approach criteria cannot be satisfied, promptly execute go-around or discontinued approach.

en.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

en.source_text_en: air or sea route ： For departures from DABER heading north: after passing DABER, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to TEBON or XLN, and then to QO to join the airway. for the flight back to ZGOW, ATC may instruct the aircraft to flyfrom QO to XLN or TEBON, and then to DABER to join the arrival procedure. For ZGOW-ZGKL flights:after takeoff and upon crossing airway X63, ATC may instruct the aircraft to fly direct to SHL, followed by VEROK. For ZSNJ (Nanjing) arrivals: ATC will instruct the aircraft to flyvia EMRID to airway V143 and then to OLRIS. After OLRIS, the aircraft will proceed to SNQ (Shiqiu) or receive radar vectors to join the appropriate approach procedure. The final waypoint listed on the clearance isGOSRO (via W135). Upon passing KAKIS (the entry point to the arrival corridor), control is handled by Hangzhou Approach; the handover to Nanjing Approach often occurs late, creating a risk of flying the wrong arrival or departure route. Itis recommended to confirm the arrival procedure in advance. 4. ZGHA-ZGOW Route: After passing BEMAG, follow ATC radar vectoring to aheading of 120°, then proceed direct to NUVGA to intercept Route H25 towards QU; for the approach, follow instructions to join the QU-9WA arrival route.

揭阳潮汕.source_text_en: For Jieyang departures, Xiamen control frequently issues instructions to fly direct to PV (Liancheng VOR) and then to Qingzhou (QO). Controllers do not state the waypoint code. Since the code for Qingzhou was changed from DO to QO—and both codes exist in the navigation database—flight crews must distinguish between them carefully to avoid entering DO out of habit.

杭州萧山.source_text_en: Numerous ongoing construction works with aerodrome operational complexity. When ATC issues taxi hold instructions, some taxiway junctions are not equipped with holding position markings (e.g., prior to D8 on Taxiway C, prior to C on Taxiway D5). Crew shall maintain visual lookout, control holding position with adequate margin to prevent conflict with other aircraft.
